$comment: Carbura error catalog, the single source of truth.
Every error the user can see has a stable code like CBR-3021. The code
never changes once published: it is what a driver reads out on the phone
and what someone searches for in docs/ERRORS.md.
both mirror this file, and each has a test that fails if they drift.
info     nothing is broken, the user just needs to know
critical the person may be relying on something that is not working

errors.summary: Email or password is incorrect.
errors.cause: The credentials did not match any account.
errors.action: Check the email and password and try again.
errors.note: Deliberately does not say which of the two was wrong: telling someone an email exists confirms which accounts are real.

errors.summary: The session has expired.
errors.cause: The access token is no longer valid and could not be refreshed.
errors.action: Sign in again.

errors.summary: An account already exists with that email.
errors.cause: Sign-up was attempted with an email that is already in use.
errors.action: Sign in instead, or reset the password.

errors.summary: The password is too short.
errors.cause: Passwords must be at least 10 characters.
errors.action: Use a phrase you can remember. Length matters more than symbols.

errors.summary: This account is blocked.
errors.cause: An administrator blocked the account for abuse.
errors.action: Contact whoever administers your fleet.

errors.summary: New accounts are closed.
errors.cause: The server has sign-up disabled; accounts are created by invitation.
errors.action: Ask your team leader to create your account.

errors.summary: You still lead a team.
errors.cause: The account cannot be deleted while it owns a team. The team belongs to the people in it as much as to whoever created it, and its trip history is their record too.
errors.action: Hand the team over to another leader, or close it, and then delete the account.

errors.summary: This account has no profile yet.
errors.cause: The account exists but its Carbura profile was never created, so there is nothing on file to check the request against.
errors.action: Open the app again. It creates the profile by itself the first time it loads. If this keeps happening, sign out and sign back in.
errors.note: Kept apart from CBR-1005 on purpose. Both refuse the request, and the server is right to refuse either way, but telling somebody their account is blocked when it simply has no profile yet sends them looking for a punishment that does not exist.

errors.summary: That team code is not valid or has expired.
errors.cause: No active team matches the code.
errors.action: Check the code with your leader. Codes are 8 characters and never contain the letter O or the digit 0.
errors.note: Says the same thing for a non-existent code and an expired one, so probing cannot tell them apart.

errors.summary: Too many failed attempts.
errors.cause: More than 10 wrong codes in 15 minutes.
errors.action: Wait a few minutes before trying again.

errors.summary: That team is full.
errors.cause: The team has reached its member limit.
errors.action: Ask the leader to raise the limit or remove inactive members.

errors.summary: You are not in that team.
errors.cause: The action requires membership, and you left or were removed.
errors.action: Join again with the team code.

errors.summary: Only the team leader can do that.
errors.cause: The action is restricted to leaders.
errors.action: Ask your leader.
errors.note: Enforced by the database, not the UI. Even a modified app gets rejected.

errors.summary: That team has ended.
errors.cause: Teams are temporary and this one passed its end date.
errors.action: Ask your leader to create a new one.

errors.summary: You have reached the limit of active teams.
errors.cause: A person can own at most 20 active teams.
errors.action: Archive a team you no longer use.

errors.summary: You already have a trip in progress.
errors.cause: Only one trip can be live at a time.
errors.action: Finish or cancel the current trip first.

errors.summary: That trip is already finished.
errors.cause: Completed and cancelled trips cannot be reopened.
errors.action: Start a new trip.
errors.note: Reopening an old trip would allow backdating false positions onto it.

errors.summary: Only your leader can change this destination.
errors.cause: The trip was dispatched by a team leader.
errors.action: Ask your leader, or leave the team if you should not be under dispatch.

errors.summary: No route exists that fits this vehicle.
errors.cause: No road on the way allows the declared height, weight or cargo.
errors.action: Check the vehicle's height and weight are correct, or pick a different destination.
errors.note: A legitimate and frequent answer for trucks, not a malfunction.

errors.summary: That destination is outside the mapped area.
errors.cause: The route falls outside the map region loaded on the server.
errors.action: Contact whoever administers the server: the map region needs to be extended.

errors.summary: Your leader changed the route.
errors.cause: The team leader assigned a new destination while driving.
errors.action: Follow the new directions when it is safe to do so.
errors.note: Not a failure. It is announced loudly on purpose: finding out late is worse than the change itself.

errors.summary: This trip has no route yet.
errors.cause: The route has not been calculated.
errors.action: Calculate the route before starting to navigate.

errors.summary: Carbura cannot access your location.
errors.cause: Location permission was denied.
errors.action: Grant location access in system settings. Without it there is no navigation.

errors.summary: Navigation will stop when the screen turns off.
errors.cause: Background location permission was not granted.
errors.action: Allow location "always" so directions continue with the phone in your pocket.

errors.summary: Location is turned off on this phone.
errors.cause: System location services are disabled.
errors.action: Turn on location in system settings.

errors.summary: You have left the assigned route.
errors.cause: Your position is outside the route's tolerance corridor.
errors.action: Return to the route, or recalculate if the road is blocked.
errors.note: Your leader is notified. Nothing is blocked: blocking a driver would be dangerous.

errors.summary: This phone is reporting a simulated location.
errors.cause: The operating system reports the position comes from a mocking app.
errors.action: Turn off the mock location app. Your leader has been notified.

errors.summary: Too many position updates.
errors.cause: More than 180 positions were sent in one minute.
errors.action: Usually a bug in the app. Restart it.

errors.summary: This phone's clock is wrong.
errors.cause: The device clock differs from the server by more than five minutes.
errors.action: Set the date and time automatically in system settings.
errors.note: Positions are still recorded, but flagged for review.

errors.summary: Place search is unavailable.
errors.cause: The search server did not answer.
errors.action: Try again, or pick from your saved places.

errors.summary: Showing saved results.
errors.cause: There is no connection, so previously saved results are being used.
errors.action: Nothing. Addresses rarely move, but results may be out of date.

errors.summary: Nothing found for that search.
errors.cause: The search returned no results.
errors.action: Try fewer words, or the street and city separately.

errors.summary: You already saved a place with that name.
errors.cause: Home and Base can only exist once each.
errors.action: Rename the existing one, or save this as a custom place.

errors.summary: No connection.
errors.cause: The device could not reach the server.
errors.action: Check your signal. Navigation continues with the route already downloaded.

errors.summary: The server took too long.
errors.cause: The request exceeded its time limit.
errors.action: Try again in a moment.

errors.summary: The server had a problem.
errors.cause: The server returned an unexpected error.
errors.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, report this code.

errors.summary: The routing server is not responding.
errors.cause: Valhalla is unreachable or still building its map.
errors.action: Try again shortly. After a fresh deploy, building the map takes a while.

errors.summary: This version of the app is too old.
errors.cause: The server sent data this version does not understand.
errors.action: Update Carbura.

errors.summary: The app is not configured.
errors.cause: Required server addresses were not provided at build time.
errors.action: Rebuild with the required --dart-define values. See the README.

errors.summary: This server does not have that address.
errors.cause: The app asked for something the server does not serve. Either the app is older than the server, or it is pointed at the wrong address.
errors.action: Update the app. If it is already up to date, check the server address it was built with.
errors.note: Answered at the front door rather than by the service behind it, so a request for an address that does not exist never costs any work. Anything that is not a real endpoint gets this, which also means a scan of common paths learns nothing from the difference between them.

errors.summary: This vehicle has no height or weight declared.
errors.cause: Routing will treat it as an ordinary vehicle.
errors.action: Add the height and weight before navigating. Without them the route may pass under a bridge your truck does not clear.
errors.note: The single most consequential missing field in the whole app.

errors.summary: Those dimensions look wrong.
errors.cause: A value is far outside what a real vehicle measures.
errors.action: Check the units. Height goes in centimeters, weight in kilograms.

errors.summary: You have no vehicle set up.
errors.cause: No default vehicle is registered for this account.
errors.action: Add your vehicle so routes account for its size.

errors.summary: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.cause: The database rejected the operation.
errors.action: If you believe this is wrong, report this code.

errors.summary: Too many requests.
errors.cause: The rate limit for this action was exceeded.
errors.action: Wait a moment and try again.

errors.summary: An impossible jump in position was detected.
errors.cause: The distance between two positions implies a speed no vehicle reaches.
errors.action: Usually a GPS glitch. If it repeats, your leader will be notified.

errors.summary: The app was built with a server key.
errors.cause: A server-side key was found in the app configuration.
errors.action: Rebuild with the public key. A server key inside an app exposes the entire database.
errors.note: The app refuses to start. This is intentional.

errors.summary: Something went wrong.
errors.cause: An error occurred that the app does not recognize.
errors.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, report this code with what you were doing.

errors.summary: The app received data it does not understand.
errors.cause: The server response did not match the expected shape.
errors.action: Usually means the app and the server are different versions. Update the app.
